question: Jam na. rogo am woodi caɗeele — haakooji nannduɗi e kube-kube. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: cassava mealybug (Phenacoccus manihoti) woni ko bonnata ndemri maa. mealybug ina muusa ndiyam haako. Ko mbaɗata: yamir wasp Apoanagyrus lopezi ngam sarrifde. Woto yejjito — ina ustina mawnugol rogo no feewi.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow haɓugo ñoɓɓe ga manoma rogo

question: Nnọọ. oka m nwere nsogbu — akwụkwọ na-akpọnwụ n'etiti. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: stem borer (Busseola fusca) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. moth na-etinye akwa n'azụ akwụkwọ. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa carbofuran mgbe ihe ọkụkụ ruru ogologo ikpere. Echefula — ikpuru na-emebi mgbọrọgwụ site n'ime.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma oka

question: Nnọọ. agwa m nwere nsogbu — ihe ọkụkụ gbara akpụ na akwụkwọ odo. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: bean fly (Ophiomyia phaseoli) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. larvae fly na-egwu oghere n'ime mgbọrọgwụ. Ihe ị ga-eme: kụọ ọsọ iji zere oge weevil. Echefula — tinye mulch n'akụkụ ihe ọkụkụ.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma agwa

question: Assalamu alaikum. gero ta na da matsala — hatsi marasa cika da tsutsa a ciki. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: millet head miner (Heliocheilus albipunctella) ne ke damun amfanin gonar ka. moth pest of pearl millet. Abin da za ka yi: shuka da wuri don guje wa lokacin kwari. Kada ka manta — amfani da iri masu jurewa kamar ZATIP.
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar sarrafa kwari ga manoma gero

question: Jam na. Miɗo yiɗi anndude no mi waɗirta ɓuuɗa citta e ndemri citta am. Ɗume wasiyiiji maa?
answer: Wasiyanke am dow ɓuuɗa citta e citta: fuɗɗu aawɗe nder nursery. Ɗum wallitata sabo waylu caggal yontere 6-8. darnde 45cm hakkunde puɗi, 60cm hakkunde layi.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow kuugal remo ga manoma citta

question: Ina kwana. Na ga kwasfa suna juya baki da fari mai kama da gari a jikin koko ta. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: black pod disease (Phytophthora megakarya) ce ke cutar amfanin gonar ka. Tana yaduwa ta hanyar cutar koko mafi tsanani a yammacin Afirka. Magani: cire kwasfa masu cuta da fesa jan karfe fungicide. girbi da wuri — jinkiri yana kara lalacewa.
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar gano cuta ga manoma koko

question: Ek'abo. Mo fe mo bi mo se le gbìn gbogiri fun oko gbogiri mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori gbìn gbogiri fun gbogiri: gbìn irugbin taara sinu oko. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe duro 2m laarin awọn ila, 1m laarin irugbin. kankana n fẹ oorun ati ilẹ to dara.
source: Ile-eko IAR&T ti Obafemi Awolowo University, imoran ise agbe ga manoma gbogiri

question: No wa'i. Miɗo yiɗi anndude no mi waɗirta sarrifde ndiyam e ndemri marori am. Ɗume wasiyiiji maa?
answer: Wasiyanke am dow sarrifde ndiyam e marori: reendu ndiyam haa timmo 2-5cm nder saha tillering. Ɗum wallitata sabo ɓuusu luumo ñalɗi 10 aduna faggudde. waylude ndiyam e yoora ina reena ndiyam.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow kuugal remo ga manoma marori

question: A salaamun alaikum. la'ano am woodi caɗeele — ɓutte tokosɗe nder haako bano harsashi. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: okra flea beetle (Podagrica uniforma) woni ko bonnata ndemri maa. yawnu hakkunde ina bonnata haako puɗi. Ko mbaɗata: fesa man neem e huunde eedu. Woto yejjito — ɓuuɗa da yaawde ngam yiilde saha beetle.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow haɓugo ñoɓɓe ga manoma la'ano

question: Mbaaɗa. Mi yi'i ratsi boɗeejo nder rogo e rogo am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: cassava brown streak disease woni rafi bonnata ndemri maa. Ɗum saakitoo e whiteflies e yankan cuuɗi. Nyawndam: mbarodit e jawtude puɗi cuuɗi on. rafi ina waddana rogo cuuɗa — ɗanɗano metteeɗo.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow anndingo rafi ga manoma rogo

answer: amaranth stem borer woni ko bonnata ndemri maa. larvae moth ina ɓutta nder ɗaɗol. Ko mbaɗata: fesa man neem. Woto yejjito — ittu puɗi cuuɗi.

question: Jam na. mbayeeri am woodi caɗeele — haakooji caka ina yoora nder puɗi. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: sorghum shoot fly (Atherigona soccata) woni ko bonnata ndemri maa. ƴiiƴam ina darii dow haako tokosɗo. Ko mbaɗata: ɓuuɗa da yaawde ngam yiilde saha ƴiiƴam. Woto yejjito — huutoro aawɗe juriyeeje hono SAMSORG 40.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow haɓugo ñoɓɓe ga manoma mbayeeri

question: Sannu. Mi yi'i haakooji oolooji e daneeji les e sunflower am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: downy mildew woni rafi bonnata ndemri maa. Ɗum saakitoo e fungus ina ngooda nder leydi. Nyawndam: huutoro aawɗe juriyeeje. waylitu ngal luumo duuɓi 3.

question: Jam na. masar am woodi caɗeele — ɓutte nder haako e tsutsa nder haakooji. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: fall armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda) woni ko bonnata ndemri maa. ñoɓɓe ina waɗa ƴiiƴam jemma dow masar — larvae ina nyaama nder. Ko mbaɗata: fesa neem (azadirachtin) e fuɗɗude mawnugol. Woto yejjito — rafi ina saakitde da yaawde tawa nyaw — ɗaɓɓu gollal nder ñalɗi 3.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow haɓugo ñoɓɓe ga manoma masar

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Ahụrụ m ntụpọ ntụ n'elu akwụkwọ ala na oka m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?

question: Nnọọ. Ahụrụ m ntụpọ aja aja n'elu akwụkwọ na green m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: leaf spot (Alternaria amaranthi) na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus na-agbasa site n' mmiri ozuzo. Ngwọta: fesa jan karfe fungicide. belata ọnụọgụ mmiri n'elu akwụkwọ.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma green

question: Se dada ni. Mo fe mo bi mo se le itọju igi mangwaro fun oko mangoro mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori itọju igi mangwaro fun mangoro: ge awọn ẹka ti ku ni gbogbo ọdun. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe fi takin organic ni ayika gbongbo. omi didun ni akoko oorun.

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi nlekọta ehi na-amụ nwa n'ugbo mmiri ara m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka nlekọta ehi na-amụ nwa na mmiri ara: amụ ehi ugboro abụọ n'ụbọchị na ụtụtụ na mgbede. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na nọgide ọcha ebe ịmụ nwa. nye nri dị mma na mmiri dị ukwu.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma mmiri ara

question: E karo. Mo ri wipe kabeji mi ni ihò kekeke ninu ewe ati idin alawọ. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: diamondback moth (Plutella xylostella) lo n damu oko re. moth n bi ẹyin labẹ ewe. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: fesi Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis). Ma gbagbe — yi iyipada oko lati fọ iyipo igbesi aye.
source: Ile-eko IAR&T ti Obafemi Awolowo University, imoran isakoso kokoro ga manoma kabeji

question: A salaamun alaikum. Mi yi'i foda orange les haako e kofi am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: coffee leaf rust (Hemileia vastatrix) woni rafi bonnata ndemri maa. Ɗum saakitoo e fungus ina yaaka e henndu. Nyawndam: fesa fungicide jan karfe. ɓuuɗa aawɗe juriyeeje.

question: Se dada ni. Mo ri wipe baba mi ni ewe aarin ngbo ninu irugbin. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?

question: Ek'abo. Mo ri ewe tinrin ti won kojo si oke lori ogede mi. Arun wo ni eyi?
answer: banana bunchy top virus lo n ba oko re je. O n tan kaakiri nipa aphid-transmitted, ko si oogun. Itoju: lulẹ ki si ba irugbin arun jẹ. lo suckers alai arun lati orisun igbẹkẹle.

question: Assalamu alaikum. Na ga tsirrai suna tsuguno da ganye masu taruwa a jikin gyada ta. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: groundnut rosette virus ce ke cutar amfanin gonar ka. Tana yaduwa ta hanyar aphids suna yada shi, babu maganin sinadarai. Magani: amfani da iri masu jurewa kamar SAMNUT 24. tumɓuke da ƙona tsirrai masu cutar.

question: Kedu. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi ọrụ ugbo owu n'ugbo cotton m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?

source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma cotton

question: Jam na. koko am woodi caɗeele — tolleeji dow kwasfa e puɗi. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: cocoa mirids (Sahlbergella singularis) woni ko bonnata ndemri maa. mirids ina ɓittinde ndiyam bonniiɗam. Ko mbaɗata: fesa bifenthrin e adadu laaɓɗo. Woto yejjito — sarrifde innde ina ustina yawnu mirid.

question: Ndewo. akpu m nwere nsogbu — akwụkwọ odo nwere ntụpọ. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: cassava green mite (Mononychellus tanajoa) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. mites na-agbasa n'oge ọkọchị. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa mmanụ neem ma ọ bụ acaricide. Echefula — ọrịa siri ike na-ebelata rogo site na 60%.

question: No wa'i. ayaba am woodi caɗeele — larvae ina ɓutta nder corm ina waddana lekki yani. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?

source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow kuugal remo ga manoma dankali

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. osikapa m nwere nsogbu — akwụkwọ yiri ọkpọ (ọlaọcha ome). Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?

question: Kedu. akpu m nwere nsogbu — akwụkwọ odo nwere ntụpọ. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: cassava green mite (Mononychellus tanajoa) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. mites na-agbasa n'oge ọkọchị. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa mmanụ neem ma ọ bụ acaricide. Echefula — ọrịa siri ike na-ebelata rogo site na 60%.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma akpu

question: Ina kwana. shayi ta na da matsala — tabo masu duhu a kan ganye da ƙananan harbe. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: tea mosquito bug (Helopeltis antonii) ne ke damun amfanin gonar ka. bug yana huda ganye yana tsotse ruwa. Abin da za ka yi: fesa neem oil. Kada ka manta — datse rassan da suka kamu.
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar sarrafa kwari ga manoma shayi

question: E ku ise. Mo ri ami dudu lori ewe ati iku oṣan lori isu mi. Arun wo ni eyi?
answer: yam anthracnose (Colletotrichum gloeosporioides) lo n ba oko re je. O n tan kaakiri nipa fungus n tan kaakiri ni akoko ojo. Itoju: lo irugbin to n lagbara bi TDr 95/19177. ma ṣe igbìn sinu ilẹ omi.
source: Ile-eko IAR&T ti Obafemi Awolowo University, imoran iwadii arun ga manoma isu

question: Sannu. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka albasa a aikin albasa don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka albasa a aikin albasa: shuka iri kai tsaye ko ta nursery. Wannan yana taimakawa domin tsaya 20cm tsakanin layuka, 10cm tsakanin tsirrai. albasa tana buƙatar rana sosai.
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar aikin gona ga manoma albasa

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi nlekọta osisi nkwu n'ugbo nkwu m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka nlekọta osisi nkwu na nkwu: tinye fatịlaịza NPK 15-15-15 kwa afọ. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na chapụ akwụkwọ kpọrọ nkụ mgbe niile. sachaa gburugburu osisi iji belata ahụhụ.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma nkwu

question: Se dada ni. Mo ri ami dudu lori ewe ndin photosynthesis din ku lori ogede mi. Arun wo ni eyi?
answer: black sigatoka (Mycosphaerella fijiensis) lo n ba oko re je. O n tan kaakiri nipa fungus n tan kaakiri pẹlu afẹfẹ. Itoju: fesi fungicide nigbakugba. ge ewe arun.
source: Ile-eko IAR&T ti Obafemi Awolowo University, imoran iwadii arun ga manoma ogede

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Ahụrụ m ntụpọ ojii na akwụkwọ na ire ure nke mkpụrụ osisi na tomato m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: late blight (Phytophthora infestans) na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus na-abawanye n'oge oyi na mmiri. Ngwọta: fesa mancozeb maka mgbochi. akpọla tomato nso n'ubi potato.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma tomato

question: Sannu. Na ga farin foda a kan furanni da ganye a jikin kanju ta. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: powdery mildew ce ke cutar amfanin gonar ka. Tana yaduwa ta hanyar fungus yana hana samar da 'ya'yan itace. Magani: fesa sulfur fungicide. datse don iska mai kyau.
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar gano cuta ga manoma kanju

question: Jam na. koko am woodi caɗeele — tolleeji dow kwasfa e puɗi. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: cocoa mirids (Sahlbergella singularis) woni ko bonnata ndemri maa. mirids ina ɓittinde ndiyam bonniiɗam. Ko mbaɗata: fesa bifenthrin e adadu laaɓɗo. Woto yejjito — sarrifde innde ina ustina yawnu mirid.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow haɓugo ñoɓɓe ga manoma koko

question: E karo. Mo ri wipe alubosa mi ni ewe alawọ fadaka ti lọ. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: onion thrips (Thrips tabaci) lo n damu oko re. thrips nfa omi ninu ewe. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: fesi oṣẹ kokoro. Ma gbagbe — gbìn alubosa jinna si awọn oko allium.
source: Ile-eko IAR&T ti Obafemi Awolowo University, imoran isakoso kokoro ga manoma alubosa

question: Kedu. watermelon m nwere nsogbu — ikpuru n'ime mkpụrụ osisi na-eme ka ha ree ure. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?

source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma watermelon

question: Ek'abo. Mo ri irugbin ngbo lairotẹlẹ lori tomatii mi. Arun wo ni eyi?

question: Jam na. Mi yi'i haakooji oolooji e ruɓol ɗaɗol e tamaro am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: basal stem rot (Ganoderma boninense) woni rafi bonnata ndemri maa. Ɗum saakitoo e fungus ina ngooda nder leydi e tarkace lekki. Nyawndam: ittu e jawtu leɗɗe cuuɗe. laaɓɗin luumo gila tarkace lekki.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow anndingo rafi ga manoma tamaro

question: E karo. Mo ri iyanfun funfun lori ewe lori gbogiri mi. Arun wo ni eyi?

question: Assalamu alaikum. Na ga tabo masu launin ruwan kasa a kan ganye a jikin alaiho ta. Wace cuta ce wannan?

source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar gano cuta ga manoma alaiho

question: Ek'abo. Mo ri wipe ere mi ni ihò ninu eso ati idoti. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?

source: Ile-eko IAR&T ti Obafemi Awolowo University, imoran isakoso kokoro ga manoma ere

question: Sannu. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka kankana a aikin kankana don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?

question: Ek'abo. Mo ri wipe epa mi ni irugbin kukuru pelu ewe ti lọ. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?

question: Assalamu alaikum. Ina so in san yadda zan ruwan shayarwa a aikin tumatir don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?

question: Ina kwana. Na ga tabo masu launin toka a kan ƙananan ganye a jikin masara ta. Wace cuta ce wannan?

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi kụọ tii n'ugbo tii m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka kụọ tii na tii: kụọ n'elu ala nwere mmiri mmiri. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na kwụsị 1.5m n'etiti ihe ọkụkụ. chapụ mgbe niile maka eto ọhụrụ.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma tii

question: Nnọọ. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi kụọ sunflower n'ugbo sunflower m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka kụọ sunflower na sunflower: kụọ mkpụrụ na omimi 2-3cm. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na kwụsị 75cm n'etiti ahịrị, 30cm n'etiti ihe ọkụkụ. sunflower chọrọ anyanwụ nke ukwuu.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma sunflower

question: Ina kwana. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka gyada a aikin gyada don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka gyada a aikin gyada: shuka iri a zurfin 5cm. Wannan yana taimakawa domin tsaya 60cm tsakanin layuka, 15cm tsakanin tsirrai. gyada tana buƙatar ƙasa mai sauƙi (sandy loam).
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar aikin gona ga manoma gyada

question: Barka dai. Na ga farin gashi a kan ganye a jikin albasa ta. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: onion downy mildew ce ke cutar amfanin gonar ka. Tana yaduwa ta hanyar fungus yana yaduwa a lokacin danshi. Magani: rage yawan shayarwa. shuka iri masu jurewa.
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar gano cuta ga manoma albasa

question: Assalamu alaikum. Na ga ganye masu rawaya da ruɓewar tushe a jikin dabino ta. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: basal stem rot (Ganoderma boninense) ce ke cutar amfanin gonar ka. Tana yaduwa ta hanyar fungus yana rayuwa a cikin ƙasa da tarkacen itace. Magani: cire da ƙona bishiyoyi masu cuta. tsaftace gonar daga tarkacen itace.
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar gano cuta ga manoma dabino

question: Sannu da aiki. kiwo ta na da matsala — ƙanƙara a jikin shanu suna tsotse jini. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: ticks (Rhipicephalus microplus) ne ke damun amfanin gonar ka. ticks suna watsa cututtuka kamar East Coast fever. Abin da za ka yi: wanka shanu da acaricide a kowane mako 2. Kada ka manta — kiyaye kiwo da tsafta don rage ticks.
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar sarrafa kwari ga manoma kiwo

question: Sannu. Na ga ganye suna bushewa daga gefe a jikin shinkafa ta. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: bacterial leaf blight ce ke cutar amfanin gonar ka. Tana yaduwa ta hanyar kwayar cuta tana yaduwa da ruwa. Magani: shuka iri mai lafiya da aka tabbatar. ruwan sama da yawa yana kara yaduwa.
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar gano cuta ga manoma shinkafa

question: Ek'abo. Mo fe mo bi mo se le gbìn gbogiri fun oko gbogiri mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori gbìn gbogiri fun gbogiri: gbìn irugbin taara sinu oko. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe duro 2m laarin awọn ila, 1m laarin irugbin. kankana n fẹ oorun ati ilẹ to dara.
source: Ile-eko IAR&T ti Obafemi Awolowo University, imoran ise agbe ga manoma gbogiri

question: Nnọọ. kabeji m nwere nsogbu — obere oghere n'akwụkwọ na larvae akwụkwọ ndụ. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: diamondback moth (Plutella xylostella) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. moth na-etinye akwa n'okpuru akwụkwọ. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis). Echefula — gbanwee ihe ọkụkụ ugbo iji mebie usoro ndụ.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma kabeji

question: Sannu. Na ga tabo masu launin ruwan kasa a kan ganye a jikin alaiho ta. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: leaf spot (Alternaria amaranthi) ce ke cutar amfanin gonar ka. Tana yaduwa ta hanyar fungus yana yaduwa da ruwan sama. Magani: fesa jan karfe fungicide. rage yawan shayarwa a kan ganye.
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar gano cuta ga manoma alaiho

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi kụọ ogede n'ugbo unere m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka kụọ ogede na unere: kụọ suckers ahụike na omimi 30cm. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na kwụsị 3m n'etiti ihe ọkụkụ. nye mmiri mgbe niile n'oge ọkọchị.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma unere

question: A salaamun alaikum. nyebbe am woodi caɗeele — haakooji cuuɗiiɗi e ruwan zuma jalboowo. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: cowpea aphid (Aphis craccivora) woni ko bonnata ndemri maa. aphids ina moofta dow haako tokosɗo. Ko mbaɗata: fesa ndiyam neem walla sabu rayde ñoɓɓe. Woto yejjito — aphids ina saaktinde mosaic virus.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow haɓugo ñoɓɓe ga manoma nyebbe

question: A salaamun alaikum. Mi yi'i tolleeji ndiyam dow haako e lawol am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: bacterial blight (Xanthomonas campestris pv. malvacearum) woni rafi bonnata ndemri maa. Ɗum saakitoo e kwayar cuta ina saakitde e ndiyam dow. Nyawndam: huutoro aawɗe alaa rafi. waylitu ngal luumo duuɓi 2.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow anndingo rafi ga manoma lawol

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Ahụrụ m ntụpọ mmiri n'elu akwụkwọ na mkpụrụ na agwa m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: common bacterial blight na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na nje na-agbasa site n' mmiri ozuzo. Ngwọta: arụla ọrụ n'ugbo mgbe akwụkwọ juru mmiri. jiri mkpụrụ na-eguzogide ọrịa.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma agwa

question: Barka dai. kankana ta na da matsala — larvae a cikin 'ya'yan itace suna sa su ruɓe. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: melon fruit fly (Bactrocera cucurbitae) ne ke damun amfanin gonar ka. ƙuda tana huda 'ya'yan itace don yin kwai. Abin da za ka yi: rufe 'ya'yan itace da takarda. Kada ka manta — girbi da wuri kafin kwari su taru.
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar sarrafa kwari ga manoma kankana

question: A salaamun alaikum. sunflower am woodi caɗeele — larvae nder hoore sunflower ina nyaama aawɗe. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: head moth (Homoeosoma electellum) woni ko bonnata ndemri maa. moth ina waɗa ƴiiƴam dow piindi. Ko mbaɗata: fesa Bt nder saha piindi. Woto yejjito — ɓuuɗa aawɗe juriyeeje.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow haɓugo ñoɓɓe ga manoma sunflower

question: Assalamu alaikum. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka kabeji a aikin kabeji don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka kabeji a aikin kabeji: fara iri a cikin nursery. Wannan yana taimakawa domin dasawa bayan makonni 4-5. tsaya 45cm tsakanin tsirrai.
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar aikin gona ga manoma kabeji

question: Sannu da aiki. koko ta na da matsala — tabo a kan kwasfa da harbuna. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: cocoa mirids (Sahlbergella singularis) ne ke damun amfanin gonar ka. mirids suna allurar ruwan guba. Abin da za ka yi: fesa bifenthrin a daidai adadin. Kada ka manta — sarrafa inuwa yana rage yawan mirid.
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar sarrafa kwari ga manoma koko

question: Se dada ni. Mo ri ami olomi lori ewe ti ndi brown lori ere mi. Arun wo ni eyi?
answer: cowpea bacterial blight lo n ba oko re je. O n tan kaakiri nipa ojo n tan kaakiri kokoro arun na. Itoju: fi oogun onirin (copper fungicide). lo irugbin alai arun to ni idaniloju.
source: Ile-eko IAR&T ti Obafemi Awolowo University, imoran iwadii arun ga manoma ere

question: E ku ise. Mo fe mo bi mo se le yiyan ege rogo fun oko pakí mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori yiyan ege rogo fun pakí: lo ege ilera gigun 20-25cm pelu nodes 5-7. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe gbìn ni igun 45-digiri. ege ti ko ni arun lati awọn ile-iwadi.
source: Ile-eko IAR&T ti Obafemi Awolowo University, imoran ise agbe ga manoma pakí

question: No wa'i. Mi yi'i farin foda dow haako e kankana am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: powdery mildew woni rafi bonnata ndemri maa. Ɗum saakitoo e fungus ina saakitde nder saha njamndi. Nyawndam: fesa sulfur fungicide. ustina ɓuuɓri dow haako.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow anndingo rafi ga manoma kankana

question: Sannu da aiki. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka albasa a aikin albasa don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka albasa a aikin albasa: shuka iri kai tsaye ko ta nursery. Wannan yana taimakawa domin tsaya 20cm tsakanin layuka, 10cm tsakanin tsirrai. albasa tana buƙatar rana sosai.
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar aikin gona ga manoma albasa

answer: melon fruit fly (Bactrocera cucurbitae) ne ke damun amfanin gonar ka. ƙuda tana huda 'ya'yan itace don yin kwai. Abin da za ka yi: rufe 'ya'yan itace da takarda. Kada ka manta — girbi da wuri kafin kwari su taru.
source: Hukumar NAERLS da ke ABU Zaria, shawarar sarrafa kwari ga manoma kankana

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. kashu m nwere nsogbu — alaka nwụrụ anwụ na oghere n'ụgbụgbọ. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: cashew stem girdler na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. beetle na-ebipụ alaka. Ihe ị ga-eme: chapụ alaka butere ọrịa. Echefula — sachaa ugbo.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma kashu
